newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan LTCB, NCB cut prime rates to 2.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Japan LTCB, NCB cut prime rates to 2.7 pct.

text.p: Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan Ltd (LTCB) and Nippon Credit Bank Ltd (NCB) said separately on Tuesday that each had cut its long-term prime rate by 0.3 percentage point to 2.7 percent, effective from Wednesday.
The two banks will also cut the coupon rate on their debentures to be issued this month by the same margin of 0.3 percent point from their issues in September, they said.
As a result, the October LTCB debenture will carry a coupon rate of 2.0 percent, while the NCB rate will be 2.25 percent.
On Monday, the Industrial Bank of Japan Ltd (IBJ) announced it was cutting its long-term prime rate and its debenture coupon rate by 0.3 percent point to 2.7 percent and 1.8 percent, respectively.
The three long-term credit banks have been adopting the same prime rate, while their debenture rates have varied in response to market levels.
